Subject: Interested in pricing + demo (saw pricing CTA)

Hi Marissa,

I submitted the pricing CTA form earlier and wanted to follow up directly. We run personalization and search across 1200 stores and are evaluating inference costs — specifically for embeddings + chat flows for our merchandising team. Would love a quick demo and an idea of pricing for a mid-volume production workload.

A few details:
- Usage: ~10M tokens/month estimate, serving a mix of batch embeddings and chat endpoints
- Region: US (prefer east coast)
- Timeline: aiming to pilot in 6–8 weeks

Can you share availability this week or next for a 30-min demo? Also, if you need any details beforehand I can loop in procurement (procurement@zenithretail.com).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director of Product
Zenith Retail
